== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Arenas in this setting are diverse combat environments used for various types of sanctioned or specialized fighting. Some structures are circular and constructed from [[orus wood]], featuring tiered seating organized by clan colors—such as purple and white for the Wei, green and gray for the [[Li]], and brown and red for the [[Kazan]]—with a separate high box reserved for guests from the four Schools. These arenas may feature large etched [[scripts]] to contain power within the combat area. Other venues are massive, square-shaped spaces with [[stone]] floors that can be divided into sections to accommodate multiple simultaneous fights for different ranks of combatants, ranging from [[Foundation]] children to [[Jades]]. Many arenas are highly customized or magically altered to suit specific matches or combatants. These modifications can include the addition of pillars to restrict movement and sight, the use of [[shadow madra]] to isolate fighters from spectators, or the creation of complex three-dimensional mazes filled with [[steel]] and [[stone]]. Some environments are entirely artificial or temporary, such as an arena built atop a massive tree to host a [[tournament]], or specialized combat spaces featuring waterfalls, solidified [[blood]] blades, or irregular [[stone]] and lightning. Spectators often watch from specialized towers, such as the eight towers built to showcase [[Monarch factions]], though some arenas can be sealed off by [[madra]] so that audiences must rely on viewing projections. In extreme cases, arenas can be destroyed, leaving only rubble behind.}}
